text.en: This Order may be cited as the Anti-Terrorism (Amendment) Order, 2012. of section 2 of S 45/2011.
Section 4 of the principal Order is repealed and the following new section substituted therefor - or collection of property to commit terrorists acts, for terrorist group or

Section 11 of the principal Order is amended by adding the following new subsection immediately after subsection (2) - "(3) For the purposes of this section, "recruit" or "recruits" includes abet, induce, incite, instigate, encourage and solicit.".

Section 15 of the principal Order is amended by adding the following two new subsections immediately after subsection (2) - "(3) Where any articles of, or relating to, or purporting to relate to, any terrorist group is found in the possession, custody or under the control of any person, it shall be presumed, until the contrary is proved, that such is a member of the terrorist group.

Made this 26th. day of Rejab, 1433 Hijriah corresponding to the 16th. day of June, 2012 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
